activity.notes: Obalókun is remembered in Oyo historical tradition as an expansionist Alaafin associated with Oyo's first direct Atlantic-facing expansion. Early Oyo regnal chronology is highly uncertain: modern reconstructions variously place him around 1588–1599 or in the 1620s. ATLAS therefore uses only c.1600 as a representative rule point rather than inventing a precise reign interval.

sources.title: Akinwumi Ogundiran, The Yoruba: A New History
sources.citation_text: Ogundiran discusses Obalókun as an expansionist Alaafin in the reconstructed political history of Oyo.
